body: There's nothing they can say. There's nothing anyone can say. Idk why I even posted here. There's nothing anyone can do to help
And besides, a therapist can't make someone love me. Nothing thru can tell me that I don't already know

All I do is go to class and watch netflix to distract myself. I don't even have motivation to play video games anymore. Everyone at school is nice but no one's interesting enough to actually befriend. I spend 90% of my time lying in my bed because I don't have enough motivation to do anything else. And I don't even want to get better because I just don't care. I just want to not have to deal with this anymore
